It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that the mother in law of the deceased was enlarged on bail vide order dated 31.07.2024.
The applicant is the brother in law.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 31.07.2024 coupled with the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant, who is the brother in law, the Nayeem vs State Of U.P. 1 applicant who is in custody since 30.04.2024 is enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Nayeem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Nayeem be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 215 of 2024, 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Gangaghat, District Unnao, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
